source_description_html:
TCX RT-Race Boots

From the storied heritage of TCX’s racing line, the TCX RT Race Boots are their most streamlined track boot to date. With a strong and lightweight microfiber construction, the TCX RT Boots maintain protection with a lighter, more comfortable feel. The toe slider, shift pad and closure strap are formed from polyurethane, which is used in conjunction with magnesium to form the heel slider and with iron mesh intake vents to create the shin plate. The over-injected front and side panels allow easy step-in, and the FFC (Fasten Fit Control) with internal laces joined to the boot lining results in a precise, secure fit that maximizes protection. In the ankle, the TCX R T Race Boots feature the DFC (Double Flex Control System) to allow lateral and longitudinal movements only within physiological limitations, while preventing excess torsion and minimizing risk of injury. For the track rider seeking Italian race boots without compromise in either ergonomics or protection, the TCX RT-Race Boots are an excellent choice.

Features:

  • Durable, lightweight microfiber upper
  • Over-injected front and side panel to allow an easy step-in and a precise fit around the foot/leg
  • Padded rear flex area for a better comfort
  • Abrasion-resistant microfiber heat guard
  • FFC Fasten Fit Control lacing system
  • Soft microfiber gaiter for a perfect fit around the calf
  • Air Tech breathable lining soft touch mesh combined with double density foam for superior comfort around the ankle
  • DFC Double Flex Control System 
  • Polyurethane shin plate with iron mesh air intakes and micro injections
  • Polyurethane shift pad integrated in the sole
  • Ergonomically designed polyurethane heel counter
  • Replaceable abrasion-resistant polyurethane toe slider
  • Replaceable magnesium and polyurethane heel sliders
  • Outside elastic zipper and VELCRO® brand tab closure
  • Micro-adjustable aluminum buckle and polyurethane-toothed band to allow perfect fastening of the shin plate around the calf
  • Replaceable anatomic insole
  • Reinforced midsole with differentiated thickness
  • Lightweight, mono compound rubber sole

source_description_html:
The RT-Race Pro Air motorcycle boot is the top-of-the line Racing model, resulting from collaboration between the TCX R&D Department and professional MotoGP™ riders. RT-Race Pro Air incorporates Fasten Fit Control, an internal lacing system connected to the boot lining through a quick-slide lace, so that the upper can wrap round the foot as much as possible and the fit can be personalized right down to the millimeter. The boot fastening system features an aluminum lever with micrometric adjustment and quick release, designed so that the shaft can adapt perfectly to various calf shapes, and a side zipper with stretch panel. TCX RT-Race Pro Air motorcycle boots are equipped with the anti-twist Double Flex Control system, a polyurethane joint in the ankle area able to control movement down to the millimeter, offering ideal joint support and flexibility, to prevent dangerous twisting and the risk of injury. The upper is made of highly wear-resistant microfiber and perforated, to ensure optimal ventilation for the foot and maintain perfect comfort even at high temperatures.The inner lining is made of breathable AIR TECH mesh fabric and has a padding with different thicknesses in the ankle area to offer maximum comfort. The “Burnout” sole is inspired by the Michelin® “Power Supersport Evo” tire. It features a bi-compound tread with differentiated grip areas, designed to ensure superior grip on foot pegs and controls and greater resistance to wear and abrasion from asphalt. The profile is fully integrated with the upper and the heel angle ensures optimal position on the foot pegs. There are interchangeable magnesium sliders on the toe and heel to aid sliding when in contact with the asphalt. There are more polyurethane reinforcements in the most exposed areas, such as the shin, ankle, toe and heel.

source_description_html:
Yes. The name may sound more like a country club. And the Dartwoods may resemble hikers or perhaps topsiders more than the average riding shoe, but, nevertheless, the TCX Dartwood Gore-Tex Boots smash together the style of a round toe chukka with performance and comfort that raise TCX's longstanding moto reputation to new levels.

The Dartwood GTX Riding Shoes use a leather upper that is backed by a Gore-Tex Extended Comfort inner membrane. This membrane provides a waterproof barrier that is breathable and guaranteed for life. The list of Who's Who does not stop there. The sole and footbed are crafted by industry specialists Groundtrax and Ortholite, respectively. Impact-absorbing malleolus inserts are sourced from D3O. TCX engineers the ZPLATE midsole in-house - striking a balance between transverse rigidity, crush resistance and walking comfort.

Gore-Tex versions of the Dartwood receive blacked-out TCX branding, black round rope boot-style shoe laces and black soles. Red stitching accents the seam between the leather upper and toe.

Features: 

  • Full grain leather upper
  • GORE-TEX Extended Comfort breathable inner membrane
  • Reinforced midsole with ZPLATE shank to balance flexibility with transverse rigidity 
  • Reinforcements on malleolus with D3O inserts
  • Reinforcements at toe and heel
  • Rear reflective insert
  • Lace closure with elastic band to store the laces
  • Easy entry inner side zipper
  • OrthoLite footbed with long term cushioning and high levels of breathability
  • Oil-resistant Groundtrax rubber outsole
  • CE 13634:2017 certified

If you have classic taste, the TCX Fuel Waterproof Boots are sure to stoke your fire. Engineer boots were originally designed to have a single piece of leather on the forefoot with minimal exposed seams to protect the engineer’s feet from rogue hot coals. In the construction of the Fuel Boots, TCX recognized that this still-valid design has a different utility to the modern motorcyclist - the handsomely finished full grain leather upper is backed with a full waterproof lining to repel any sort of weather, water or grime the road throws at you. The TCX Fuel Boots are loaded with all the modern moto niceties like reinforced leather shift pads, medial and lateral malleolus discs, toe and heel counter and a grippy lug sole. With a pair of TCX Fuel WP Boots in your closet, you’ll want to fuel up before every ride.

The Street 3 Waterproof Riding Shoes continue TCX's long tradition of performance and comfort. The "Street" family of moto-specific riding shoes has always sported a strong features list including impact-mitigating ankle cups, a crush resistant midsole and reinforced toe box. What really honed the "street" cred of the Street series was the striking balance between riding features, protection and general comfort. Wear them daily. Wear them on a scooter. Wear them on a 'Busa. Take a walk to Wawa in them. If you have feet, you're ahead of the curve: The TCX Street series is simply excellent footwear - regardless of application.

Motocross and enduro boots that offer maximum protection, perfect ankle support in every phase of riding and optimal comfort for longer sessions.
